title: ED seizes property worth Rs 63.3 lakh in connection with UKSSSC paper leak
summary: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has attached properties worth Rs 63.3 lakh in connection with the alleged paper leak of the Uttar Kashi Shiksha Samiti (UKSSSC) exam papers. The ED alleges that the accused, Rajesh Kumar, pocketed ₹95 lakh from the leaked papers. The UKSSSC exam was scheduled to take place on March 10 but was postponed due to the leak. The ED is investigating the matter and has attached several properties belonging to Rajesh Kumar. The investigation is ongoing.
